selection: Existing routes only; no queries, headers or bodies replayed or added. Path order is not an outer/inner causal join.

limits.counterOverflow: Diagnostic stops and best-effort logger-error; application flow continues
limits.globalMergedStdoutBound: Not established by per-component cap; future owned capture needs its separate file bound.

loggerFailure: Every helper catches ordinary JS exceptions, attempts one bounded logger-error if space/stdout permit, stops further records. A failed stdout may prevent that error record too; absence cannot pass. Uncatchable engine/host traps are not promised catchable.

init.stateFirstAllocated: Selected deployed request after actual Request creation, or its synchronous selected Node handler observation

adapter.token: Separate component-local counter held in handleResources local completionTrace across existing awaits; never current-global
adapter.bytes: readBytes/readChunks count chunks returned by existing reader; not successfully written/peer-received bytes. EOF only when existing part.done branch is taken; a no-body response has no fabricated EOF.

catchFlags.4: outputFinished variable; set before original finish call, not proof it returned

adapter.caught: typeof or null only; no exception object/name/message serialization or primary-error changes

postCleanupFlags.1: primarySet; caughtType is typeof/null of primaryValue only when primarySet
postCleanupFlags.2: cleanupReturned as computed by original finally

adapter.normalReturnSite: Immediately after original primary/fatal guards, with no new return/await. Can be reached on original accepted handled-closed path, not only normal finished-body path; no public Promise-settled or host-quiescence claim.

classic.token: Independent component-local counter at synchronous genuine requestHandler wrapper, never assumed equal to adapter token
classic.handler: Return requestHandler(req,res) directly, no await. Only public once finish/close observers; no error listener or new HTTP handler/endpoint.

correlation.sequenceScope: Component-local emission-attempt sequence only; counters reset from snapshot and can collide/interleave across component instances in one stdout
correlation.rule: Public metadata may be compared only with genuine Root/NetLog/request/cardinality evidence; numeric tokens/sequence remain descriptive and may collide. No raw ID join, Store/resource/realm identity, POST-to-inner-GET cause or completion proof.

interpretation: Explicit adapter-catch is evidence of a guest-observed exception at the recorded existing phase. Keep native primary/falsy-error/cancel/disposal semantics unchanged.
A finish-return marker proves that the imported public OutgoingBody.finish call returned at that site, not a private finish-call count, hostTCP EOF, browser completion or resource retirement.

Finish-return precedes original finally and final guards. Post-cleanup only proves that original finally reached its end and records primarySet/cleanupReturned; original releaseInput or another uncaught cleanup exception can bypass this marker. Missing is unobserved. Normal-return-site records fallthrough after both unchanged guards, not Promise settlement, export-return observation or host quiescence.
A complete unambiguous adapter trace plus browser abort locates a public completion disagreement; it does not prove browser-only cause or exclude host transport behavior.
Public classic finish/close is lane-local. GET/action-result can be an independently handled route and is not identified as a particular POST self-fetch by equality/path/order.
No normal marker, missing lane or lost log is not proof that native append, fetch EOF or private cleanup failed.

preserved.metadataFixed31Build39Source18: Future genuine constructor mechanism; no concrete authority here

futureHostCaptureRequirement: Standard Wasmtime42 --no-logging-prefix explicitly selected, or a separately reviewed authenticated prefix-aware parser; default prefix is logging metadata, not Store identity.
perturbation: Added public header observations, metadata fields and larger bounded synchronous stdout can perturb timing; the separately selected browser header can affect framework behavior. No fix, reliability or old-profile equivalence claim.

publicCorrelation.corr: Only an exactly validated64lowercasehex value is emitted, else null. Public metadata, not authentication.
publicCorrelation.corrCount: 0,1,2;2 means at least2 available matching field names. No arbitrary count/text emitted.

classification.valid: available count1, valid shape and exactly64lowerhex value
classification.missing: available count0 and absent value with valid shape
classification.invalid: nonmatching value/count or malformed available classic shape; corr=null

publicCorrelation.adapter: Count in the sole existing fieldResource.entries loop before the unchanged append. After Request construction read its Headers.get inside an exception-isolated helper. No second WASI headers resource or body read.
publicCorrelation.classic: Independent genuine own-data lowercase req.headers value and own-data rawHeaders name slots. Count available names case-insensitively; rawHeaders is already normalized from Web Headers, not original wire duplication proof. Do not invoke accessor values.
publicCorrelation.malformedClassicShape: Non-array/missing rawHeaders, odd array length or non-string available name slots is invalid/unjoined unless at least2 available matching names already establish duplicate.
publicCorrelation.observerExceptions: Ordinary observation exceptions call the existing no-throw logger-fault path; may stop diagnostics, never change application result or original primary error. Failed stdout/uncatchable traps may prevent that marker.
publicCorrelation.invalidMetadata: Missing/invalid/duplicate values still create ordinary admitted-route trace records; they never reject or rewrite the request.
publicCorrelation.snapshots: Taken independently once per lane before the existing handler call. No global current value, lane token copying, new holder or cross-lane implicit join.
publicCorrelation.loggerFrames: logger-error/truncated retain their short reserved schema without correlation fields.
publicCorrelation.futurePublicJoin: Only future genuine Root nonce manifest+actual browser POST/PW/NetLog cardinality+one unambiguous valid adapter-enter and classic-enter can support observed public-metadata joining. Equal values can be replayed/forwarded, never private identity/causal/completion proof.
